description: This file defines the class Kint_Decorators_Plain, which provides methods for decorating and formatting debug output, including trace visualization, colorization, and header rendering for variables and call stacks.

classes.name: Kint_Decorators_Plain
classes.description: Provides static methods for decorating debug variables and traces with color and formatting in different output modes.

methods.name: decorate
methods.description: Recursively formats a kintVariableData object into a decorated string with optional levels of indentation.

methods.name: decorateTrace
methods.description: Formats a trace data array into a decorated string representation, including function calls and objects.

methods.name: wrapStart
methods.description: Returns opening HTML tags or wrappers for the decorated output based on mode.

methods.name: wrapEnd
methods.description: Returns closing HTML tags or wrappers, optionally including caller information.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes color settings based on environment and returns style tags if in plain mode.
